title: BuiltinLoadout
description: One builtin deck JSON document (src/server/content/loadouts/<archetype>.json). Structural shape only — rules legality (known ids, 40–50 cards, ≤3 copies, face-deck cap 12, opening dice) is validateLoadout.

squad.description: Three creature definition ids, deployment order. Exactly one must be legendary (checked by validateLoadout, not this schema).

deckCounts.description: Tactics/ritual copies expanded to a 40–50 card list. At most 3 copies per cardId.

faceDeck.description: Named specials (and dual-kind naturals that occupy the 12). Untyped Shield and opening naturals do not consume the face-deck cap when used as startingDice basics.

startingDice.description: Two opening d6 of six face ids each (already expanded naturals + Shield). dicePerPlayer is 2; FACE_SLOTS_PER_DIE is 6.
